bounded_parameter_space: Exclude entries when regime is classified as 'long' or 'short'
hypotheses.falsification_test: Backtest S03 with trend regime exclusion; falsified if net R in neutral regime degrades or if trade retention drops below 40% overall.
hypotheses.single_axis_change: Restrict entries to neutral regimes only
hypotheses.why: The strategy exhibits extreme regime concentration. Trend regimes are completely toxic (PF < 0.06), while neutral regimes are highly profitable. This filter is strongly supported across all windows (W1, W2, W3).
